blocks.text: Paris, France—The European Union is to unveil proposals Wednesday aimed at curbing addictive features of social media for minors, as a growing number of countries look to restrict children’s access to the platforms. More than 20 countries around the world have now taken steps to block or restrict children going online on social media, according to an AFP tally. Seven have measures already in place or set to be implemented, with their policies targeting children under the age of 15 or 16.
